en.docNoDating: Text nodes do not carry a separate “formation / textual fixation” dating: for a single scripture the origin of its teaching and the fixing of its text are often centuries apart, and that distinction belongs to the nodes that discuss the text (layer 04, layer 12), or to a search of the canon index.

en.metaDesc: A single-page reference to Buddhist doctrine: twelve layers, 230 concepts, 790 typed relations, 549 cited passages. Each concept carries a definition, dated textual layers (formation of the idea / fixation of the text / Chinese translation), quoted sources and related nodes — covering the Four Noble Truths, dependent origination, the Nikāyas and Abhidharma, Madhyamaka and Yogācāra, tathāgatagarbha, Buddhist logic, the Chinese schools, Tibetan and Theravāda transmissions, the stages of practice and the history of the texts. Bilingual, self-contained, works offline.

支分.hint: whole and part: contains, opens into, divides

因果.hint: cause and result: root, produces, ripens

判摄.hint: a school's placement of a concept

对辨.hint: two positions set against each other

修证.hint: doctrine and its practice: method, object of contemplation

依据.hint: the scripture or reasoning relied on

early.hint: core teachings shared before the schisms; present in both the Pali Nikāyas and the Chinese Āgamas

develop.hint: formed in the centuries after the Buddha: śāstras, Mahāyāna, doctrinal classification, schools

folk.hint: material serving popular religious needs; different in kind from the doctrinal layers

modern.hint: modern methods of study and modern forms of practice; not doctrine

meta.hint: methodology and conclusions about how the texts themselves came to be
